paper_title: Search for Dark Photon Dark Matter in the Mass Range 41--74 $μ\mathrm{eV}$ using Millimeter-Wave Receiver and Radioshielding Box
notes: Paper reports upper limits χ < (0.5–3.9) × 10^−10 at 95% CL in the mass range 41–74 µeV (frequency range 10–18 GHz). Data points represent the lower and upper bounds of the exclusion region: 41 µeV = 4.136e-5 eV (10 GHz) with χ = 5e-11, and 74 µeV = 7.448e-5 eV (18 GHz) with χ = 3.9e-10. The coupling constant χ is the kinetic mixing parameter between dark photons and ordinary photons. DM density ρ = 0.39 ± 0.03 GeV/cm³ is used in the signal power calculation (Eq. 1). No significant signal detected; global p-value = 2.2%. Systematic uncertainties total 5.7–9.7%. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.92, 2))
